text: At 59', Ironvale Athletic leveraged their 5-3-2 low block and deep defensive line to absorb Redmond Rovers' high press and quick circulation, triggering counterattacks through direct, vertical passing. This tactic led to 4 final-third entries and an xG of 0.84 over the 8-minute momentum window, despite only 43.8% possession and a higher PPDA of 7.8 signaling lower pressing intensity than Redmond's 5.2. The momentum index drop to -0.643 captures Ironvale's successful transition mechanism, exploiting spaces behind Redmond's high defensive line. Their persistence culminated in a high-quality chance by Jonah Lindqvist at 61' (xG 0.74), converted into a goal, demonstrating clinical execution of their counter-attacking overload strategy [#1133] [#1157] [#1066].
